questions.text: Every room you enter for the rest of your life plays one song as you walk in. Pick it, and think carefully.
Your life gets a permanent narrator. Whose voice, and what tone are they taking?
You get one undo button, usable once, on anything in your life. Do you use it now or save it forever?
You can download one skill perfectly, but you lose a skill you already have. What's the trade?
Time travel exists but you can only observe, never interact. Where and when are you going first?
You stop ageing at whatever age you pick, forever. Which age, and what's the catch you're accepting?
You wake up fluent in three languages you don't speak. Which three, and what do you do with them?
You're given a fully paid house anywhere on Earth, but you can never move again. Where do you put it?
You get a deliberately unimpressive superpower — always finding parking, perfect toast, never losing keys. Which is genuinely the strongest?
You can change the size of exactly one species permanently. Which one, and what size?
You're invisible for 24 hours with no consequences. Realistically, what do you actually spend it doing?
Ten million arrives tomorrow, but you must spend it all within a year and can't give it away. What's the plan?
Design your last meal, including the setting and who is at the table. Details matter.
You can learn the exact date you'll die, or never know. Which envelope do you take?
You swap lives with anyone in this server for one week. Who, and what's the first thing you'd do with their life?
A museum builds one exhibit about your life. Which three objects are behind the glass?
You restart your life at eighteen in a country you've never visited. Which country are you picking?
Every app on your phone is deleted except three. Which three survive, and which loss hurts most?
You can read minds, but only when someone is thinking about you. Blessing or curse?
You can pause the world for an hour a day, but you age normally during it. How do you spend the hour?
You get a clone who shares your memories and must be paid a fair wage. What job do you give yourself?
You wake up six inches tall in your own home for one day. What's your survival plan?
You can teleport anywhere instantly, but you arrive completely naked. How often are you still using this?
Everyone on Earth is forced to be honest for one hour. Are you excited or terrified?
You get to add one law that everyone on the planet must follow. What's the law, and what's the loophole people will find?
One person you know becomes immortal and they get to choose you as their permanent companion. Do you accept?
You get a lifetime supply of one thing, delivered weekly, no substitutions. What are you picking?
Desert island, one book, one album, one luxury item that isn't a boat. Go.
You get a TV remote for real life: pause, rewind, fast-forward, mute. Which button do you wear out first?
Aliens land and ask for one human to explain us. Who do you send, and what do they get wrong?
You can permanently forget one thing — a memory, a skill, a song, an ex's phone number. What goes?
One animal species will now obey your commands, but only yours. Which species, and what's the first order?
You get a five-minute video of your life exactly one year from today. Watch it or delete it?
You must switch to a completely different career tomorrow, with full training paid. What are you doing?
You control the weather in a ten-mile radius around yourself. How long before your neighbours turn on you?
You only need two hours of sleep a night, forever. What do you fill the extra six with — honestly?
One food becomes nutritionally perfect and you may eat unlimited amounts of it. Which food are you choosing?
You get sixty seconds on the phone with yourself ten years ago. What do you say, knowing they might not listen?
You must wear a warning label about yourself for a year. What does it say?
A theme park builds one ride based on your life. What's it called and what's the biggest drop?
You inherit a struggling business tomorrow. Which industry would you actually want it to be in?
Any fictional character becomes your real-life mentor for a year. Who, and what are they teaching you?
You must give up one sense to sharpen another to superhuman levels. What's the trade you'd make?
Would you rather be famous but hated, or brilliant at something and completely unknown?
Your next life is set in a fictional genre of your choosing. Which genre, and what role are you playing in it?
A vending machine appears in your home that dispenses anything under twenty dollars, once a day. What's your daily pull?
